THE_EXPRESSIBLE_REMEDY_FOR_THE_NEXT_CUT.arm: a brace family's enumerated members must be VERIFIED PRESENT by an instrument OUTSIDE the manifest before the builder may emit them as an enumeration; where verification fails, the subject carries a DECLARED PATTERN plus population_status transient, never a member list.
